title: A dream about a mall I'd visited before (in a dream)
content: My dream today started in a mall for the first time in a week or so. I entered the mall through the front doors into a dome-like area with lots of orange and warm colors. I walked down the stairs towards a hall that led to the entrance to a sort of living space. To get in there I had to stabilize the floor, which seemed to float on top of a water like substance (it tilted with my weight). To do this I pressed a button and the door in front of me opened. The next sequence was me and my partner taking care of a small dog while cleaning around the space. At some point there was a trainer for the dog and for some reason she couldn't get along with me. I walked after her through parts of the mall, promising to be different so we could get along. But she stopped reacting, so I walked back to the living space. When I entered she was there again and there were three other people as well (partner was not there anymore). I apologized to her and admitted this wouldn't work out. She taught me how to clean the floor with a dry sponge mop. She then disbanded the contract for training the dog and left. The next sequence: I was walking on the outside of the mall with my partner. There were lots of stores and the ground was made up of tiles. We went to see whether a store we frequented had new items. The 'store' looked more like a display case on the outside of a building. the floor of it was filled with white packing peanut type things and on top lay several miscellaneous items like you would see at a crane game. We were looking for a bedazzled Pokémon (more like the idea of a Pokémon) plush. It was bright green with lighter green parts. We mostly went there to see because the plush was a monthly exclusive type thing that would be switched out. The next sequence I was walking alone and someone called out to me. Three people I recognized from primary school were there and we spoke for a while. After that I went to walk around the outside and inside of the mall. The mall had a strange concept: there were two split sides of it, one intended for 'good' and happy people, the other one for 'loners' and grumpy people. I ended up having a conversation with someone who used to watch over me when I went to after-school care. The next sequence I wanted to head home from the mall. I was riding a bicycle and trying to figure out where I had come from to even get there. I went straight north and travelled through an industrial area which was mostly deserted along a straight road. Everything here was grey/white and made of stone; a heavy mist hung in the area. The next sequence I was walking through the city and trying to call my partner. My phone looked like a melting piece of clay and every time I wanted to use it I had to shape it onto a rectangle. I walked down some stairs from the outside and walked into a covered walkway. Clothing racks stood on the sides of the walkway and employees were busy organizing the products on them. At the end of the walkway there was an opening onto a balcony that looked out at a fish-processing factory a couple of stories down. There were burly men on the balcony smoking and chatting. From this point the dream kind of separated into a new dream that revolved around me driving a car, but realizing halfway through that I had forgot to bring my drivers license with me. I ended up parking the car on a very muddy parking and rest area with a line of trees surrounding it. I walked out of the area and over a small grassy field towards a neighborhood that was built alongside a canal. There I spoke to two women about what just happened. When I felt better one of them handed me her very young baby for a minute. I held the baby and spoke to it. They then went back inside their houses (they were neighbors). From there I used my clay-like phone to call home so I could ask for help getting home (I was on the end of a peninsula and my home was on the mainland). I didn't have any service or no-one picked up, I'm not sure. In the end I was able to go home because I spilled ice cream on myself and that activated a sort of teleport back to my house. The rest is kind of vague and my dream ends soon after. Sorry for the long post, I'm just describing what I remember from last night's dream.
